target_customer: AI agent and assistant builders that want to offer travel booking, and travel suppliers selling through agents
problem: AI agents cannot reliably search and book flights, hotels and cars because travel inventory and post-booking servicing sit behind fragmented airline and hotel systems.
business_model: Usage and commission based API and MCP server for travel search and booking
product_category: Travel infrastructure API for AI agents

founders.name: Kevin Gauthier
founders.background_notes: From YC page: Mowgli reached 450K users in 6 months.

founders.name: Sebastien Texier
founders.background_notes: YC page cites 15 plus years in travel.

competitors.name: lastminute.com MCP server
competitors.what: Flight search and booking MCP server opened to AI models

competitors.name: Kiwi.com MCP server
competitors.what: MCP server letting agents search flights

competitors.name: Travala Travel MCP
competitors.what: Hotel search, booking and stablecoin payment for agents

technical_complexity.rationale: Aggregating airline NDC, hotel and car inventory and handling payments, changes and refunds for agents is integration heavy; the team has prior NDC aggregator experience.

defensibility.rationale: Supply integrations and agent distribution partnerships take time to build, but several travel platforms shipped MCP servers in 2025 and 2026, so the interface layer is copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Multiple incumbents launched agent oriented MCP servers between Aug 2025 and Nov 2026; no outcome yet for Jinko.

market_need_then: Agentic travel booking became a visible theme in 2026 coverage, with several travel companies opening MCP connectors; Jinko lists Exa, Replit and Twin among users (self reported).

branding.domain_note: Uses gojinko.com and jinko.so; the .com Jinko belongs to others so a prefix was used.

identity.logo: not described by any source found
identity.voice_and_tone: direct infrastructure positioning, The travel infrastructure built for agents

brand_strength.rationale: Name collides with JinkoSolar in search results and no brand coverage was found.

outcome_analysis: Jinko is a Fall 2026 company founded by a team that previously built and sold the travel startup Mowgli to Hopper, which gives unusual domain fit. It is active with no exit. The risk is that travel incumbents and aggregators are opening their own agent interfaces at the same time.
notes: Funding: an aggregator (Dealroom, startup-seeker) lists about a 125k seed with no investors, unverified and not recorded as a round. Competitors listed are dated 2025 to 2026 and the Fall 2026 batch had barely begun, so as_of is the batch month. Founder education only given for Shuai Zhang on the YC page. Completeness pass: the $125K seed rests on a single database (Dealroom), undated, no investors named. A French cancer-care startup also called Jinko (EUR 2M, 360 Capital) is a different company and is not recorded.
